description: Source code for a logging integration class 'BraintrustLogger' that logs success and failure events to Braintrust API, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods, environment validation, project ID management, and event data preparation.

classes.name: BraintrustLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class that logs success and failure events to Braintrust API, with methods for environment validation, project ID retrieval, and event logging (both sync and async).

methods.name: get_utc_datetime
methods.description: Returns current UTC datetime, using datetime.now(dt.UTC) if available, otherwise datetime.utcnow().

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes BraintrustLogger with optional API key and base URL, sets headers, and creates HTTP handlers.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Checks for presence of BRAINTRUST_API_KEY in environment or provided argument, raises exception if missing.

methods.name: get_project_id_sync
methods.description: Retrieves project ID by name synchronously, creating project if it does not exist, with caching.

methods.name: create_default_project_and_experiment
methods.description: Creates a default 'litellm' project asynchronously and stores its ID.

methods.name: create_sync_default_project_and_experiment
methods.description: Creates a default 'litellm' project synchronously and stores its ID.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event to Braintrust synchronously, preparing event data from response and context.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event to Braintrust, similar to log_success_event but with async HTTP calls.

methods.name: log_failure_event
methods.description: Delegates failure event logging to superclass implementation.
